Questions

Before you order

Is this for residents or attendings?

Both. The tools work at any stage, from your first year of residency to twenty years in practice.

I have no time. Will I actually finish it?

It’s 90 minutes, recorded, so you can watch it in two sittings between cases. The 5-day plan takes about ten minutes a day.

Is this therapy or medical advice?

No. It’s an educational coaching workshop. It doesn’t replace care from a licensed professional.

Why is it only $27?

Because the first step should be easy. Try the tools, and decide afterwards if you want to go deeper.

Script 1 · “The drive home”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Surgeons, how long does a hard case stay with you after you leave?”

Body

“For a lot of surgeons it’s the whole drive home, dinner, and half the night. We’re trained to perform under pressure, but nobody teaches us what to do with it afterwards. I’m an ENT surgeon and a coach, and I built a 90-minute workshop around the routine I use before and after every case.”

CTA

“It’s called the Steady Surgeon Workshop. It’s $27 and it includes a live Q&A with me. Tap Learn more.”

Shot: talking to camera in scrubs or clinic clothes, on-screen caption “the drive home”.

Script 2 · “After the next milestone”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“It’ll get easier after residency. Then after fellowship. Then after making partner.”

Body

“If you’re a surgeon, you’ve probably told yourself some version of that. The milestones keep coming, and the pressure moves with you. What changes it is how you think about the work, and that’s something you can practise this week.”

CTA

“I’ll show you how in the Steady Surgeon Workshop. 90 minutes, a workbook, and a live Q&A, for $27. Tap Learn more.”

Shot: talking to camera, each milestone appears as on-screen text and is crossed out.

Script 3 · “Why I wrote Scrubbing In”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“I’m an ENT surgeon, and here’s the thing I wish someone had told me in training.”

Body

“Being good at surgery and feeling good in surgery are two different skills. The first one gets years of training. The second one gets almost none. That’s why I wrote Scrubbing In, started Surgeons with Purpose, and why I made this workshop.”

CTA

“The Steady Surgeon Workshop is $27. Watch it this week and bring your questions to the live Q&A. Tap Learn more.”

Shot: talking to camera holding a copy of Scrubbing In, cut to workbook pages.

The case went well. So why is it still in your head at midnight?

Surgeons are trained to perform under pressure. Not to put it down.

So the pressure comes home. Every night. Every milestone.

Feeling steady at work is a skill. And skills can be learned.

A routine for the scrub sink. A debrief for the drive home.Two of the five tools in the workshop.
